description:
Add context pins (one or more) in one call. Returns `ids` in input order (null where one failed), `issues` for failures and warnings, and `checks`.

Available pin types:
• door — main entrance door (red)
• patio_door — patio/garden door (teal)
• window — window opening (blue)
• gate — garden gate/entrance (green)
• view_good — desirable view direction (yellow)
• view_bad — undesirable view to screen (grey)

label.description: Optional: Custom label for the pin

notes.description: Optional: Design notes — context about this pin, what it means for the layout

name: add_pins
